questions.question: Those amphetamines fueled paranoia until Dick saw what color laser beam in 1974?
questions.explanation: Dick described a pink beam delivering gnosis in VALIS.

questions.question: That pink beam vision led Dick to name VALIS—Vast Active Living what?
questions.explanation: Dick framed VALIS as a cosmic information network.
